parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the group to which the domain name will belong. The default value is the ID of the default group.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

Default value: en.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns add-domain --lang en --domain-name example.com --group-id defaultGroup --resource-group-id 000000resourcegroupid --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns AddDomain --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceGroupId 000000resourcegroupid --DomainName 'example.com' --Lang en --GroupId defaultGroup
